editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware — Sourcing Caveat
editorial.body: T9Pro is a real, currently-sold product across Amazon, eBay, and Fmart's China site, but no major tech press has reviewed it. Listing titles confirm 3,800 Pa suction, "AI Edge Detection," a 2.4G remote, ultrasonic-mist spray, and ten spare microfiber pads. Figures for safety-rope rating, battery-backup runtime, and water-tank capacity come only from one unreliable third-party site and are marked unverified.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: robotindex found no recalls, lawsuits, or safety-incident reports for this product in the sources reviewed. That said, no reputable tech-press review of this exact model exists, and its key specs come only from a single non-press, third-party spec database rather than manufacturer or press sourcing.
